shared_focus = {
		id = NAM_board_table_six
		icon = GFX_focus_NAM_board_table_six
		x = 20
		y = 11
		cost = 3
		prerequisite = { focus = NAM_board_copy_across_strait }
		prerequisite = {
			focus = NAM_board_chairmans_copy
			focus = NAM_board_port_rights_monopoly
		}
		available = {
			has_completed_focus = NAM_board_residency_for_hire
		}
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_POLITICAL }
		completion_reward = {
			add_political_power = 50
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_table_six_reward_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_petitioner value = 0 }
				for_loop_effect = {
					start = 1
					end = 7
					value = NAM_board_loop_step
					add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_petitioner value = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = { var = NAM_board_support^NAM_board_petitioner value = 50 compare = less_than }
						}
						set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_petitioner }
						set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 12 }
						NAM_board_support_change = yes
						# Only a running countdown restarts; a company already boycotting
						# still has to recover trust 35 (M1).
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { var = NAM_board_objection_days^NAM_board_petitioner value = global.num_days compare = greater_than }
							}
							set_variable = { var = NAM_board_objection_days^NAM_board_petitioner value = global.num_days }
							add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_objection_days^NAM_board_petitioner value = 30 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_no_confidence_immunity } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_board_no_confidence_immunity days = 90 }
				}
				NAM_board_recount = yes
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.95 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 1 }
	}

		id = NAM_board_partition_night
		icon = GFX_focus_NAM_board_partition_night
		x = 18
		y = 12
		cost = 3
		prerequisite = { focus = NAM_board_mainland_inventory }
		prerequisite = { focus = NAM_board_table_six }
		available = {
			NAM_board_majority_held = yes
		}
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_POLITICAL }
		completion_reward = {
			add_timed_idea = {
				idea = NAM_board_partition_charter
				days = 180
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_partition_night_reward_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				NAM_board_recount = yes
				set_variable = { var = NAM_board_partition_efl value = NAM_board_rank_1 }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_board_partition_azh value = NAM_board_rank_2 }
				set_country_flag = NAM_board_partition_fixed
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_partition_index value = -1 }
				for_loop_effect = {
					start = 0
					end = 6
					value = NAM_board_loop_step
					add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_partition_index value = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_order^NAM_board_partition_index }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -5 }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_index < 2 } }
						set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 10 }
					}
					NAM_board_support_change = yes
				}
				# The partition is frozen above; its two race votes end here.
				set_variable = { var = NAM_board_guarantor_vote value = 0 }
				set_variable = { var = NAM_board_keeper_vote value = 0 }
				NAM_board_recount = yes
				NAM_island_partition_succession = yes
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_revenge_readiness value = 10 }
				NAM_revenge_readiness_clamp = yes
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.81 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 1 }
	}
